unit.why: A single anecdote: the Maggid orders R. Lipman Yona to give all his money to a communal levy, blesses him as rich, and he then grows wealthy and lives long.

stories.start_quote: בשנת תקס״ח הי' עת צרה לישראל בפולין
stories.summary_en: In 1808, during a communal emergency in Poland, the Maggid orders R. Lipman Yona to give his entire fortune of fifty rubles and tells him 'you are rich'; the next day the town lord sends him to Hungary for wine, he earns over ten thousand rubles, and he lives to 108.

tags.why: The Maggid's words 'you are rich' come true.

quotes: אתה גביר ואז קיים אשר צוהו
והרויח באותה שנה יותר מעשרת אלפים רו״כ
tags.why: The prediction of wealth is fulfilled.

quotes: כי יביאו הקהל כאו"א לפי ערכו
וצוה עליו המגיד שיביא נ׳ ר"כ
tags.why: He gives all he owns to a communal collection in a time of trouble.

quotes: בשנת תקס״ח הי' עת צרה לישראל בפולין
tags.why: The story is set during a dated communal crisis in Poland.

tags.why: The town lord employs him in the wine trade.

tags.why: He obeys the tzaddik despite doubt and is rewarded; the story shows faith in the tzaddik's word.
